create_custom_dataset: create a CustomDataset instance with an annotation file and processing pipeline for object detection
load_annotations_custom_dataset: load annotations from a JSON file into the CustomDataset using mmcv load
evaluate_mAP_custom_dataset: evaluate detection results against ground truth annotations using mAP metric with IoU threshold
get_classes_custom_dataset: get class names from a file path or list to override default CLASSES in CustomDataset
prepare_train_img_custom_dataset: prepare training image data and annotations by running them through the Compose pipeline
